latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-examples skill.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) to generate AI-powered sample videos.
- Instantly preview and download 1080p MP4 outputs, ideal for marketers evaluating results before committing.
- Automatic backend connection: secures session via NEMO_TOKEN or free starter token.
- Simple commands support upload, status, credit check, and export.
- Responsive handling of uploads, edits, and timeline previews within a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Built-in error management and clear user prompts throughout the workflow.
